title: Nutty Golden Carrot & Orange Breakfast Cookies
description: Oat and wholemeal flour cookies studded with walnuts, almonds and chia seeds, flavoured with grated carrot and orange zest.
ingredients: finely grated zest and juice of 1 orange
steps: Mix together oats, flour, baking powder, salt, walnuts, almonds and chia seeds.
Make a well in the middle; add egg, vanilla, orange zest and juice.
Stir together; add grated carrot and mix thoroughly.
Line a large baking tray with parchment; spray. Form mixture into 12 balls; place on tray; flatten with a fork. Spray tops.
notes: Nuts can be swapped for hazelnuts, pistachios or seeds. Dry mix can be prepped in advance.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
